title: City Staff Preps for Top Golf Tournament!
description:
One of the biggest golf tournaments of the year happens right here at Torrey Pines Golf Course, and it’s all possible because of our incredible City staff. 

For weeks, Golf Division maintenance staff have been hard at work preparing for the Farmers Insurance Open. Thanks to their dedication, the course remains in world-class condition not just for the tournament’s top golfers, but for our community and visitors year-round!

#golf #TorreyPines #SeeYouAtTorrey
